gaps.explanation: Statement total receipts 5,949,658 (trimmed p6, Total Governmental Funds). Detail = 5,972,846, above by 23,188. The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10) prints Local 507,137 / total receipts 3,697,669, while the General Fund combining statement (p7, General Fund sub-fund column) prints Local 483,949 / total receipts 3,674,481 plus Sale of surplus 23,188 under other financing sources: 507,137 - 483,949 = 23,188. The budget schedule counts the sale of surplus as a Local receipt; the statement prints it as other financing (Sale of surplus 23,188, p5/p6 Total 178,549). Every other fund's detail ties to its statement column (Inheritance 422,031, Veteran's Aid 62, Relief 10,437, Planning & Zoning 750, Road 1,236,965, Bond 156,264, COVID 403,896, Non-major 44,772). 5,972,846 - 23,188 = 5,949,658. No fix (both printed as shown).

Statement transfers in 1,537,140 (p6 Total; General Fund column p5 prints Transfers - in 39,600, Road 1,497,540). Detail = 1,772,900: General Fund sub-fund 206,486 (p10 budget schedule / p7) + Planning & Zoning 29,274 (p8) + Health Insurance Buydown 39,600 (p8) + Road 1,497,540 (p11). The General Fund combining statement (p8 Total General Fund column) prints Transfers - in 275,360 gross between its sub-funds, while the governmental funds statement's General Fund column nets the intra-General-Fund transfers to 39,600: 275,360 - 39,600 = 235,760 = 206,486 + 29,274. Detail records each sub-fund gross; no fix.

Statement transfers out 1,537,140 (p6 Total; General Fund column p5 prints (1,311,640), COVID (225,500)). Detail = 1,772,900: General Fund sub-fund (1,547,400) (p10/p7) + COVID American Rescue Plan (225,500) (p13). Combining General Fund statement p8 Total General Fund column prints Transfers - out (1,547,400) gross; the statement column nets intra-General-Fund transfers: 1,547,400 - 1,311,640 = 235,760 (same amount as the transfers-in difference). Gross per fund vs netted column; no fix.
